description: Mobile-optimized virtual keyboard for LilyPond input. Touch targets >=48px, thumb-zone layout, context-aware layers.
designPrinciples: Primary layer = 95% of keystrokes in verified corpus
Scope-aware layers: note | chord | lyric | markup | scheme
Templates as single-tap inserts (replace-all with confirm)
Command picker reads window.LILYPOND_SYNTAX (238 verified entries)
